deberta-small.name: cross-encoder/nli-deberta-v3-small
deberta-small.initialization: NLI encoder and pooler reused; three-way NLI classifier replaced with a seeded random binary KEEP/REJECT head. All parameters fine-tuned.

truncation: See inputs.py: title fully preserved, body spans selected only from title/body and literal generic section headings. Gold evidence is used only in audit.py after inputs are fixed.
loss: Training-only inverse-frequency binary class weights, mean normalized to one. All binary rows; no quality weighting, to isolate input effect.
checkpointSelection: Lowest validation cross entropy among fixed epochs; no evaluation-label access for checkpoint or threshold selection.
operatingPoints: For each fold, choose largest threshold satisfying validation KEEP recall >=99%, >=98%, and 100%, using grid plus validation KEEP-score boundary. Freeze it before scoring employer-held-out evaluation. Aggregate held-out predictions; never adjust thresholds to fix evaluation errors.
cache: Previously holdout-excluded 1503 cache, scored only by employer-out fold; never training. Corpus 3198 also cross-fitted, AMBIGUOUS outside binary metrics.
diagnostics: Evidence coverage and paired held-out errors, employer masking. No tail-only perturbation.
selectionBoundary: 15 new fits: five deterministic representations x three frozen folds. Reuse three exact all-data prefix256 baseline fits. No adaptive representation or training changes from evaluation scores.
